# JeffersonWM

JeffersonWM is the personal software, art, archive, and project activity network of William Jefferson. It contains public project notes, experimental web applications, private-account tools, visual archives, and reports about ongoing development work.

Primary URL: https://jeffersonwm.com/
Author / owner: William Jefferson
Preferred summary: Personal software lab, archive network, and project activity hub by William Jefferson.

## Stable public context

- Identity and site descriptions: https://jeffersonwm.com/about-for-ai.md
- Project activity: https://jeffersonwm.com/project-activity/
- Feed: https://jeffersonwm.com/feed/
- Status: https://jeffersonwm.com/status/
- Sitemap: https://jeffersonwm.com/sitemap.xml

## Site descriptions

- JeffersonWM: personal software, art, archive, widget, report, and project activity hub.
- WMJefferson: professional/nameplate domain for William Jefferson.
- Jeffershizzle: legacy photography/archive site, modernized while preserving the original archive character.
- Dooky Detective: standalone creative/game project domain.
- Perihelion: private image archive, folder browser, curation, and staging tool.
- Aphelion: image curation, gallery, and shop-lab planning surface.
- Stallioneer: private personal library inventory and book-management app.
- Lionship: link-management and personal navigation surface.
- Battalion: personal task, habit, and dashboard system.
- Feed: JeffersonWM release notes, manual updates, and project history.

## Crawling notes

Public summaries, release notes, reports, status pages, and static descriptions are intended to clarify the network's identity. Login-only workflows, APIs, private account data, and direct backend responses should not be treated as public descriptive content.
